title: Cover Codex stdin command-loop budget selection and reset after an interrupt
outcome: Behavioral tests exercise the production per-command stdin budget selection and prove that an InterruptTurn uses its thirty-second budget while the next ordinary command on the same writer returns to the sixty-second budget.
acceptance: A behavioral test drives the production command-dispatch path for InterruptTurn followed by an ordinary command on the same watched writer and observes their distinct deadline behavior.
The coverage fails if the production budget-selection call is removed or if the ordinary command stops resetting the previous interrupt budget, without real thirty- or sixty-second waits.
Existing stdin guard cleanup and Stop behavior continue to pass; source review and relevant verification evidence are recorded.
